description:
The Huffy MotoX 16" Kids Bike is made for young riders ready to take on bigger adventures. Its durable steel frame and motocross-inspired design bring bold style to every ride, whether kids are cruising the neighborhood or racing friends down the sidewalk.
The MotoX features Huffy’s EZ Build system, designed to make bike assembly faster and simpler. With a streamlined setup process and fewer steps, parents can get the bike ready with less hassle so kids can start riding sooner.
Training wheels provide extra stability while riders build balance and confidence. A coaster brake allows easy pedal-back stopping, while the front hand brake adds responsive control as riding skills grow. Wide tires and comfortable grips help keep every ride steady, smooth, and fun.

components.description: Dual Brake System: Coaster brake for easy pedal-back stopping plus a front hand brake for added control as skills grow.
